description: Connect ChatGPT to QA Wolf to inspect authorized workspaces, explore a staging app in a cloud browser, request test implementation from QA Wolf AI, run existing tests and review results. Follow live session links and verify validation, publication and draft or active readiness separately. Tools also manage test configuration, flow tags, issues, scheduled or deployment triggers, and workspace test email. A QA Wolf account with the required workspace permissions is needed. Runner and AI work can incur charges, and test actions can change the application under test. Connected integrations can publish code or send messages.

defaultPrompt: Help me choose and create the first test flow for my app.
